content.title: Where to watch the Detroit Pistons vs. Washington Wizards for free tonight
content.text: Detroit Pistons center Jalen Duren (0) grabs a rebound against Washington Wizards forward Anthony Gill during the first half of an NBA basketball game, Tuesday, March 17, 2026, in Washington. (AP Photo/John McDonnell)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Detroit Pistons are back at Capital One Arena tonight for another matchup with the Washington Wizards. Fans can catch the game on FanDuel Sports Network Detroit Extra at 7 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo and DirecTV Stream. Both streaming services offer free trials and first-month discounts for new customers. Streaming OptionsAll columns visible (no scrolling needed)The Pistons will be without their star guard, Cade Cunningham, after the team announced he suffered a left lung pneumothorax in Tuesday’s game against the Wizards. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks. Despite losing Cunningham in the first quarter, the Pistons were able to come away with a 130-117 victory over the Wizards. Jalen Duren led Detroit with a career-high 36 points and 12 rebounds, while Bub Carrington led Washington with 30 points. The win improved the Pistons to 49-19 overall, which is the best in the Eastern Conference.
